profile.name: Yousif Mohannad
profile.summary: Hands-on cybersecurity practitioner working across offensive and defensive security, including penetration testing, red teaming, vulnerability research, threat intelligence, malware analysis, network security and security detection engineering.
about: I am a cybersecurity engineer with a practical Blue Team focus, including threat detection, log analysis and incident response. I work with Splunk, Wireshark and Suricata to understand network behavior and identify malicious activity.
I actively train through TryHackMe and Hack The Box labs, with a strong interest in SIEM, secure network protocols, SOC procedures and continuous hands-on learning.
